The New World Order

The concept of a "New World Order" (NWO) is one of the most enduring conspiracy frameworks. Historically, the phrase has been used in political science and by statesmen to refer to a new period of history characterized by a dramatic change in world political thought and the balance of power. However, in conspiracy theory circles, the New World Order refers to the emergence of a totalitarian world government. The theory posits that a secretive global elite is working to replace sovereign nation-states with an authoritarian world government. This narrative often draws on antisemitic tropes, such as the "Protocols of the Elders of Zion," alleging that Jewish bankers or Illuminati members are pulling the strings behind the scenes. Modern iterations often implicate organizations like the United Nations, the World Economic Forum, or the Bilderberg Group as the architects of this plot.

The Deep State

The term "Deep State" originated in Turkey ("Derin devlet") to describe a clandestine network of military officers, intelligence agencies, and organized crime that operated independently of the elected government.

In the American context, the term was adopted to describe the supposed existence of a coordinated body of individuals—often career bureaucrats, intelligence officials, and military leaders—who manipulate government policy regardless of which political party is in power. Proponents of this theory argue that this "state within a state" protects its own interests and subverts the will of the voters. While political scientists acknowledge that bureaucracies have inertia and institutional interests, the conspiracy theory version asserts that this group is actively malevolent and orchestrates events to maintain control.

QAnon

Emerging around 2017, QAnon is a more modern and decentralized conspiracy theory. It centers on the anonymous posts of "Q," who claimed to be a high-level government official with Q clearance. The theory alleges that a cabal of Satan-worshipping pedophiles—consisting of high-ranking Democrats, Hollywood elites, and "globalists"—controls the world.

Conspiracy theories also exploit normal features of human cognition. People are pattern-seeking creatures.
